title.narrative: Rodrigues Airport Development Project

description.narrative: Rodrigues is a 108-square-kilometer outer island of the Republic of Mauritius, about 560 kilometers east of Mauritius. It is part of the Mascarene Islands which include Mauritius and La Réunion.Air transport facility in Rodrigues is not fully efficient because the sole runway of the island can only accommodate small aircrafts (ATR-72) with a payload of up to 64 passengers because of its short length (1500 meters long x 30 meters wide) instead of the normal load of 72 passengers. Also, for pilots who are not used to operating on this runway, the take-off and landing operations are quite challenging, as (i) the current runway is 100 meters too short for even the ATR-72 aircrafts operations and (ii) has an inherent defect in the surface level, which implies that pilots do not have visibility on the whole length of the runway. Finally, depending on meteorological conditions, aircrafts operations are cancelled or rescheduled. The main objectives of the project are (i) to improve the national, regional and international connectivity and accessibility of Rodrigues island, (ii) to contribute to its social and economic development, and (iii) to increase the safety and efficiency of the airport: it is therefore a project of territorial continuity and planning development within the Republic of Mauritius. In order to be compliant with the ICAO, the construction of the Runway will entail the construction of a new Control Tower, new ARFFS, new Taxiways, new Aircraft Parking Stands.
